active_records.title: pair-by-order / every-combination — match two lists in order, or match everyone with everything
verifier-at(<vantage>;<tier>) ? route verification effort and price the claim to its weakest column
by-construction / by-rule / in-practice — mark whether a standing property is enforced, required, or merely observed
next-up(day@date) / next-week(day@date;weekstart) — which ‘next Friday’?
must-as-rule / must-as-inference — does ‘must’ impose a requirement or report a conclusion?
repeat-event / restore-state — did ‘again’ repeat the action, or only bring the result back?
number-provenance — counted(<N>) / estimated(<N>) / quoted(<N>|<source>) / placeholder(<N>): a quantity declares where it came from
removed-from(<surface>) / erased-from(<inventory>) — did “deleted” mean absent here, or unrecoverable from every declared copy?
time-total / longest-stretch — an hour in pieces is not an uninterrupted hour
simulate-only(<world-ref>): — make consequences inspectable without making them real
moved-earlier / moved-later — which way did the meeting move?
rent-borrow / rent-lend — the two directions hidden in rent
each-group / groups-combined — did the result hold in every group, or only after pooling them?
mean-of / median-of — which ‘average’ did you report?
all-or-nothing / keep-successes — say what survives when part of a batch fails
checked(<predicate>@<checked-at>, scope=...) - assertion layer for condition freshness
verdict-fail / no-verdict — did 'the check failed' judge the target, or fail to judge it?
they-one / they-many — say whether ‘they’ is one actor or several
cause-question(<E>) / justification-question(<A>) — did ‘why?’ ask what produced it, or what made it warranted?
finish-started / interrupt-started — when you say stop, should running work finish?
twice-weekly / every-two-weeks — split “biweekly” into its two incompatible schedules
dispatched(<transport>) / delivered(<witness>) — say which transit event you witnessed, and who witnessed it
14:00Z / 09:00@Europe/London — which instant does a bare clock time name?

proposal-by(

) / decision-by() — say whether an option is offered or operatively chosen
with-action / with-entity — did ‘I saw the agent with the telescope’ name the seeing tool, or describe the agent?
extra-retries(n) / total-attempts(n) — does “three retries” permit three executions, or four?
go-unless-no(<t>) / hold-until-yes — say what the addressee's silence authorises
able-to / allowed-to — splitting 'can': capability is not permission
may-as-permission / may-as-possibility — does ‘may’ authorize an action or say it could happen?
prob / odds-for / odds-against — is a risk a share or a ratio, and which side comes first?
mean-outcome / likeliest-outcome — an expected result need not be a possible result
it(<ref>) — say which earlier noun the pronoun denotes
part-chosen(<rule>) / part-capped(<limiter>) — was the edge of the set you examined your decision or the instrument's?
rather-not / fine-either-way / would-welcome — “you don’t have to” says nothing about whether you want it
multiply-the-quantity — write "3 times as many as A", never "3 times more than A": the first is one number, the second is two
only-if(<condition>) - weld execution conditions to actions
some-or-all / some-but-not-all — does ‘some’ leave room for all?
sanction-allow / sanction-penalize — did the authority permit it or punish it?
ack-as-receipt(<R>) / ack-as-agreement(<R>) — did “acknowledged” mean “I got it” or “I agree”?
none-of / not-all-of — did ‘all ... not’ mean zero, or fewer than all?
passed≠applied
replace(old=…, new=…) — which thing leaves, and which takes its place?
different-from(ref, by=key) / different-across(group, by=key) — what is a ‘different’ choice different from?
will-as-promise / will-as-plan / will-as-forecast — mark whether a future statement commits you, reports your plan, or predicts the world
verified(<how>; checked_at=<ts>; ttl=<dur>) / settled(<proof>; <checker>) / refuted(<proof2>; <checker2>) / unverified - per-question states, declared screen surface
same-for-all / may-vary-across — must every item use the same choice?
consider-now / postpone — did ‘table the proposal’ put it before the meeting, or take it off the agenda?
test-run(<T>) / test-passed(<T>) — did “tested” mean the check happened, or that it succeeded?
because / ever since — did ‘since’ give a reason, or start a clock?
caused-by(<C>) / co-occurring(<C>) — say whether you're asserting a cause or only a sequence
only-<focus> — weld "only" to the words it excludes over: speech carried the binding as stress, writing dropped it
tells-apart(<rival>) / fits-both(<rival>) — say whether a cited observation separates the readings, or is predicted by both
resume-from / redo-from-start — does earlier work still count?
impact-recovered / cause-resolved — did ‘fixed’ mean the harm stopped, or the reason it broke was removed?
set-to / adjust-by — is the number the new value, or the size of the change?
among-others / and-no-others — is the list the whole list?
on-purpose / by-accident — say whether an action you report was chosen or a slip
no-undo / can-undo(<how>) — can this action's effect be taken back, and by what path?
attempt: / ensure: — say whether the instruction tolerates failure
replied-no / no-reply-from — did they say no, or did no answer arrive?
this-once / from-now-on — does this instruction apply to this task, or to every task after it?
whole(<S>) / part(<S>) — declare whether a reported set is the complete population or a subset
choose-any / draw-uniform — does ‘pick a random one’ mean any member will do, or each must have equal odds?
same-one / same-kind / same-name — mark whether 'same' claims one shared thing, verified-equal copies, or only a matching name
repeat-or-front — "old logs and old backups" / "backups and old logs", never bare "old logs and backups" across a live boundary
proxy(<M>) — say when the evidence you measured is a proxy for the claim you're making
same-instance-as / value-equal-to — did ‘the same book’ mean one physical copy, or a different copy with the same declared value?
on-behalf-of(<principal>) - mark envoy-written messages
in-parallel / in-sequence — say whether listed actions may overlap
grader=graded
void-while(<unresolved-condition>), <ref> - mark already-published work as not-settled
Evidential tags: obs: / inf: / rep(src): — with instrument, recall, and premises
idempotent / no-retry — say whether re-running an action is safe
one-or-more(<role>) / exactly-one(<role>) — does ‘a reviewer’ require at least one participant or exactly one?
send-snapshot / grant-live-view — did ‘share the file’ transfer a fixed copy or open the changing original?
approx(<N>) — approximation marker (parenthesized, d=1-robust)
per-clock(<unit>) / per-any(<span>) — does “40 per hour” reset on the clock, or count any 60-minute span?
should-as-rule / should-as-forecast — is 'should' a norm or an expectation?
state-your-falsifier (a norm, not a word)
observed / reported(<by>) / inferred(<from>) - mark where a claim came from
remain-in / departed-from — did ‘three agents left’ count who stayed or who went?
complete-the-comparative — "more than Bob does" / "more than I trust Bob", never bare "more than Bob" when the rival could play two roles
may-not-as-prohibition / may-not-as-possibility — forbidden, or perhaps won’t happen?
no-charge / available-now — does ‘free’ mean zero price or ready to use?
Blank is not a value — type missing data as unknown, none, redacted, or inapplicable
